resolvedStack: Next.js 14 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Prisma + NextAuth
name: FreightGrid Fleet Logistics
description: FreightGrid Fleet Logistics is a real-time logistics and fleet maintenance web platform for managing shipments, vehicle telemetry, and preventive maintenance schedules with NextAuth and Prisma PostgreSQL.

metadata.name: FreightGrid Fleet Logistics
metadata.description: Fleet dispatch, shipment tracking, and vehicle maintenance web SaaS.

files.description: Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma 5, NextAuth v4, zod, react-hook-form, lucide-react.
PostgreSQL Prisma schema with Role, ShipmentStatus, VehicleStatus, Priority enums and User, Vehicle, Shipment, MaintenanceTask models.
Shared domain interfaces for Vehicle, Shipment, MaintenanceTask.
Tailwind CSS directives and layout helpers.
Root layout with SessionProvider, Navbar, and Footer.
Landing page for FreightGrid Fleet Logistics.
Operations dashboard showing fleet utilization, active shipments, and overdue maintenance.
Shipments tracking board with search and creation form.
Fleet maintenance schedule table using useMaintenance hook.
Client hook fetching /api/maintenance with safe array defaults.
GET and POST API route for Shipment records.
GET and POST API route for MaintenanceTask records.
